behavior: Fan out parallel agent tasks and deterministically fan in their evidence artifacts with conflict detection so concurrent results merge identically regardless of completion order.
nonGoals: No adapter, transport or evidence code path changes
No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: protectedTests HAR-002 is the catalog suite covering HAR-003, HAR-004, HAR-005, HAR-006 and HAR-010 (verification/test-catalog.json); per CP-002's ruling this suite will be re-cut into per-requirement sub-suites, and this contract cites the current catalog entry pending that amendment. runnerDigest is the attested G0 runner image pending a G1 runner attestation; task-ready v1 does not verify runnerDigest or testSourceDigest. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 46c8cf99cbac5d0c87729e08db20bbadbe2bacd0, computed by calling the runner's own runnerDigests() in src/evidence.ts directly rather than invented. Fan-out/fan-in is evaluated in-process over already-produced evidence artifacts; no new runtime dependency or PostgreSQL access is required, so allowedPaths stays at the default agent-harness src/test globs and no compose step is included. Separately, runnerDigest carries the attested G0 runner image digest because no G1 runner digest exists yet: the protected G1 workflow builds the image fresh from Containerfile and computes imageDigest from the built image, and conformance src/ and verification/ have grown substantially since the G0 authority commit, so the G1 image's digest will differ. task-ready v1 verifies neither digest, but readiness against a real protected run requires the pinned runner to match, so this field is a placeholder to be re-pinned to the first attested G1 runner digest. Every task contract merged to date carries the same placeholder. 2026-08-26 touch-up: protectedTests re-pointed to HARD-002 per the CP-002 re-cut now merged into verification/test-catalog.json, testSourceDigest re-pinned at structile-conformance main 20ca0d3, and baseCommit bumped to structile main 5dda0d5, retiring the stale-baseCommit task-ready violations this contract previously carried.
